_about: Design tokens for the GRAB device-art generator. Flat illustration: one shared tone ladder, crisp shadow shapes, light from the top-right at 45 degrees. Edit, run `python3 generator/build.py`, refresh art/preview.html.

tones._about: The whole set is drawn with these. edge = outline only; deep = shadow cores; mid = penumbra / recess floors; base = surfaces; lit = raised faces / light edges; white = printed lines and glyphs.

light._about: Light from the top-right. cast = how far raised parts throw their shadow down-left (px at 100px/unit); inset = width of the shadow strip inside wells.

keywave._about: Seaboard keywave, from seaboard-m.png. Fractions of a white-key pitch (x) or of the key region height (y).

grand._body: matte black, as in the Studio and Stage photos

lumi._size: fractions of a white-key pitch, measured from piano-m2.png
